name: frozen_pipeline_v1
aggregator_description: cosine of the re-normalised mean of the first k frame embeddings
centering_description: subtract the mean of all frames of strictly earlier steps of the same video, re-normalise frames; texts raw. Fallback when no earlier step: C1 (frames and texts minus the frozen train+val means, re-normalised)
c1_means_source: all 2503 train+val queries; mean over 8 frames per query (ladder cache) and mean T1 text target
template_text: a first-person photo of a person doing: {why}
